text:
The week's headlines about Jakob Chychrun have nothing to do with his scoring. His hit on Ottawa's Nick Cousins on Tuesday knocked Cousins out of the game and, per the Ottawa Citizen, out of the lineup for at least a week. The league reviewed it and deemed it clean, which did not stop the debate, or Cousins from unfollowing him online.

On the ice, the season has been a strange one. After a 26-goal year, Chychrun has 2 goals in 17 games despite 54 shots, a 3.7% shooting rate well under our range for him. His assists are fine (10 of them, 6 points on the power play), and his points per 60 sits almost exactly where we would expect. The goals are what is missing, and his wins added rank (473rd of 522 skaters) shows the cost.

Evolving-Hockey had him 23rd among defensemen last season and noted he was better than his goals even then. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking puts him among the best defensemen at reaching the slot. Watch the shot count: if he keeps firing four or five a night, the goals usually come back.
